title: Hyperthermia and Radiotherapy in arthritis
summary:
The study aims to contribute to the treatment of patients with inflammation of the small joints and tendon disorders.
The methods used to date for this purpose include low-dose radiotherapy and hyperthermia.
Both methods have been used as treatment options for years, and combining them can lead to better and faster results. 
The data collected will be analysed in relation to the affected joints, the varying efficacy of the therapy, pain relief and quality of life during follow-up care.
No additional examinations are associated with this study. 
The main objective of this study is to investigate the efficacy of hyperthermia compared to radiotherapy, as well as the combination of both methods, in terms of pain relief.
